items.proposed: code coder A row as other (HER2-negative), exploratory_correlative, candidate_matched false, arm Part 2B
items.reason: HER2-negative status is required only for the Part 2B 'esophageal, gastroesophageal (GEJ), or gastric adenocarcinoma' cohort, while glioblastoma patients enter without it; under D31-A1 a biomarker required only for a non-GBM basket cohort is exploratory_correlative, not enrichment.

The Part 2A glioblastoma cohort excludes 'Subjects with IDH-1 or IDH-2 mutations or H3 K27M diffuse midline glioma' and 'recurrent or secondary GBM', which is an IDH-wildtype requirement for glioblastoma, so cns5 under §1.1.

Same drug; the record says 'leucovorin 400 mg/m2', but manual §3 requires INN spelling, and the INN is folinic acid (both coders already used folinic acid as the agent moiety). Harmonised under D31-C2 (clarified): FOLFOX (fluorouracil, folinic acid, oxaliplatin) is given only in the non-GBM Part 2B cohort, so it is dropped; pembrolizumab (Part 1B, co-candidate) and temozolomide/radiotherapy (Part 2A) are given with M3T01 in GBM arms.

RP2D 'will be determined based upon available pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, and preliminary clinical efficacy data' (a stated PD objective for M3T01), and the trial requires pre-treatment tumour tissue plus 'a tumor accessible for biopsy while on treatment', i.e. paired tumour sampling. Under W7, a stated PD objective with paired tumour sampling = yes. No specific PD marker is named, and GBM patients 'will not undergo a protocol specified biopsy', so this is not certain.

MGMT-unmethylated status is required for the whole 'Part 2A: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma with unmethylated MGMT promoter' cohort; under the clarified D31-A2 a cohort-level requirement stays enrichment even though recurrent GBM enters Part 1 without it, and a required value is selection under D31-A8. Not candidate-matched: M3T01 is an anti-FasL antibody, not an MGMT-targeting agent.

Pembrolizumab 200 mg is fixed in the Part 1B dose-escalation arms ('M3T01 ... in combination with pembrolizumab 200 mg') for advanced solid tumours including glioblastoma, where it is not established standard care (D31-B7); an approved drug fixed in some arms whose dose is not studied is a candidate under D31-B13.

note: Harmonisation: any_molecular_selection restored to true because MGMT-unmethylated defines the whole Part 2A GBM cohort (D31-A2 clarified; D31-A8 required value), not candidate-matched (M3T01 is an anti-FasL antibody); combination_partners limited to GBM arms (pembrolizumab, radiotherapy, temozolomide; D31-C2 clarified). HER2-negative (Part 2B, non-GBM) is exploratory_correlative under D31-A1; IDH/H3K27M exclusions define GBM and are exempt (D31-A5). Pembrolizumab is a candidate (experimental_combination, D31-B13): it is fixed in Part 1B for advanced solid tumours, where it is not established standard care, although the record calls it 'standard of care'; the B7 clarification on established GBM drugs does not cover it. Regimen of the GBM arms stays combination (D31-C3). candidate_matched_selection stays false. Priority-3 arm-label and regimen_id differences not addressed.

revisions.reason: HER2-negative is required only for the Part 2B gastro-oesophageal adenocarcinoma cohort; glioblastoma patients enter without it.
MGMT-unmethylated is required only for GBM cohort Part 2A while GBM patients also enter Part 1 without it, so it is one optional route; HER2 no longer counts under A1.
Pembrolizumab 200 mg is fixed in Part 1B for advanced solid tumours including GBM, where it is not established standard care (B7), and its dose is not studied (B13).

harmonisation.reason: The clarified D31-A2 keeps a requirement for a whole GBM cohort as enrichment, and MGMT-unmethylated defines the entire Part 2A GBM cohort.

The MGMT enrichment row counts toward any_molecular_selection (D31-A8 required value); it is not candidate-matched because M3T01 (anti-FasL per the record) does not target MGMT, so candidate_matched_selection stays false.
The clarified D31-C2 does not list drugs given only in non-GBM arms, so the FOLFOX components (Part 2B gastro-oesophageal cohort only) are removed.
The only low-confidence item (MGMT cohort route) is now settled by the clarified D31-A2, and no A6 or §D check is pending (M3T01's mechanism is stated in the record).
